# `company.billing_group_members`

Membership of a customer or job in a billing group; a customer may belong to several groups.

Database: `company`.

| Column | SQL type | Nullable | Default | Key | Indexes | References | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | primary key 1 | — | — | Stable ULID of this membership. |
| `group_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | unique with group_id + customer_id, unique with group_id + position | — | billing_groups.id | Billing group this membership belongs to. |
| `customer_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | unique with group_id + customer_id | — | customers.id | Customer or job that is a member of the group. |
| `position` | INTEGER | no | — | unique with group_id + position | — | — | Order this member was placed in, from 1; the order a batch invoices in. |
| `created_at` | VARCHAR(32) | no | — | — | — | — | UTC time this membership was written. |
| `created_by` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | — | Company principal that wrote this membership. |
| `created_via` | VARCHAR(16) | no | — | — | — | — | Interface that wrote this membership. |
